description: Samenstelling verkeer is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by DONL Dataregister. Dit bestand geeft de wegintensiteit op provinciale wegen weer van motorvoertuigen en vrachtverkeer vanaf het jaar 1993. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher DONL Dataregister. Its tags are Gelderland, Motorvoertuigen, Verkeersintensiteiten, Vrachtverkeer, verkeer en vervoer. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML. The portal shows 2022-04-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
